components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5B9DFF; color: #0A0D14; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4A8CEE; }

components.name: ScoreBug
components.css: .ds-score-bug { display: flex; align-items: center; background: #000; color: #F5F7FA; height: 44px; font-family: 'SF Compact', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-score { margin: 0 12px; font-size: 20px; color: #C6F24E; }

narrative.overview: Pro Football Coach is a high-density, commute-aware college-to-pro coaching simulator designed exclusively for landscape iPhone. It balances deep management mechanics with clean, two-handed landscape ergonomics.

rules.name: The Live-Is-Now Rule
rules.body: The live chartreuse token (#C6F24E) is reserved strictly for active clocks and live call-in states.

rules.name: The 12pt Floor Rule
rules.body: No text element in any component or screen may land below 12pt.

rules.name: The Surface-Borne Depth Rule
rules.body: Dark mode conveys elevation by stepping surface lightness (#0A0D14 -> #121724 -> #1B2130).

dos: Do maintain a strict 44x44pt touch target region for all interactive controls.
Do fall back to single-column scrolling layout at AX5 Dynamic Type scale.
Do state engine-generated verdicts at the top of every READOUT screen.
donts: Don't use decorative colored side-tab borders (border-left: 3px solid).
Don't use text clipping with gradient backgrounds.
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as default section headers.
Don't allow raw text elements below 12pt.
